integrity: Complete proof and a finite exact-arithmetic verifier are included; verification cases corroborate but do not certify the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only primes dividing t have explicit discriminant valuations; no root distribution or complete integer discriminant formula. The classical t=2 simple-root subcase was established in 2014; independent validation not performed.
title: Simple roots and prime-divisor discriminants of generalized Stern polynomials
